text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: During a break one day, {0} and the others were excitedly discussing the upcoming school trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日の休み時間、{0}たちは、
修学旅行の話題で盛り上がっていた。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: A school trip, I can't wait! Hey, Hidesai, let's be in the same group, okay? Of course, Kyaru-chi too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
修学旅行とかマジ楽しみ～♪
ねーヒデサイ、
一緒に班組もーね！
もち、
キャルっちも♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Suzuna, it's great that you're excited, but don't forget there's another event before the school trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スズナー、
浮かれんのはいいけど、
修学旅行前にもう一つイベントあるわよ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Huh? What else is there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マ？　
なんかあるっけ？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Maybe the cultural festival?
text_block_list.orig_text: 文化祭かしら？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Or the sports festival?
text_block_list.orig_text: 体育祭かも！？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: It's a field trip, right?
text_block_list.orig_text: 遠足デスネ♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No, it's the final exams.
text_block_list.orig_text: 期末試験よ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Alright, this official problem is perfect. I got the answers for the applied questions too! You're doing great.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし、
この公式は完璧ね。
こっちの応用問題も正解！　
いい調子ねー

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with that? I don't really like studying, but since I came to school, I thought I might as well give it a try, and it's actually kind of fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なによ、
悪い？　
別に勉強とか好きじゃないけど、
せっかく学校来てんだしと思ってやり始めたら、
結構面白くてさ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hehe, keep it up like this, and you might do well. I never thought I'd be looking forward to the exams.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
この調子で頑張ればいい線いけるかも。
まさか試験が楽しみだなんて思わなかったわー

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Cool!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か……
かっこよ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: W-wait, I'm going to study too...!! Actually, why don't we study together?  With Eriko-pi and the others too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待ってうちもやるし……！！
ってか一緒にやろ？　
エリコっぴたちも一緒に！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well, it's fine, but what's your level? If it's not somewhat close, studying together might be inefficient.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まー別にいいけど、
あんたらレベル的にはどんな感じ？
ある程度近いレベルじゃないと、
一緒にやっても効率下がっちゃうわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Right, there's a problem set right here, so shall we try a mock exam? I'll provide the questions, and you answer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
丁度ここに問題集あるし、
軽く試験でもやってみましょうか。
じゃ、
あたしが問題出すから答えてね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: First question! "Create a sentence using the phrase 'split your sides with laughter.'" Anyone know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは第一問！
『片腹痛いを使って文章を作りなさい』
はいこれ分かる人ー？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Alright! The answer is, "I laughed so hard after eating and then running that it split my sides!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い！　
答えはー
『食べた後すぐに走ったらマジ片腹痛いんですけど！』

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No, it's not your sides, it's your ribs! It's not good to run right after eating because it's bad for digestion!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやそれ片腹じゃなくて脇腹ね！
食べた後すぐは消化に悪いから走っちゃダメよ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's easy. The answer is, "Anyone other than me who gets close to {0}-sama, I'll make them laugh so hard that I'll destroy them!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
簡単です。
答えは、
『私以外のゴミ虫が{0}様とお近づきになるなど、
片腹痛いので私の手でギタギタにして差し上げますわ』

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well, the meaning is right, but it's very personal! ...Wait, why are you glaring at me!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや意味はあってるけど私情が凄いわね！
……ってあたし睨まれてる！？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Hey, my answer is, "It's painful to laugh so hard that you split your sides!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハーイ、
ワタシの答えは、
『ハラキリすると片腹痛いデース！』

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: In what situation!?
text_block_list.orig_text: どんな状況！！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well... "Split your sides" means something is funny or ridiculous. A correct example would be, "It's painful to try to get a good score on a test without studying."
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
片腹痛いは、
ばかばかしいとか滑稽って意味よ。
正解例は『勉強しないでテストでいい点とろうなんて片腹痛い』
とかね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Okay, next! "What kind of animals are referred to as such due to having the same characteristics among mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fish?"
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいじゃあ次！
『哺乳類、
鳥類、
爬虫類、
両生類、
魚類を、
同じ特徴があることから何動物と言うでしょう？』

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: The answer is "vertebrates"! By the way, the human spine consists of 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, sacral, and coccygeal vertebrae, and by understanding this thoroughly, it's easy to...
text_block_list.orig_text:
答えは『セキツイ動物』です！
ちなみに人間の脊椎は
頚椎７、
胸椎12、
腰椎５、
仙椎、
尾骨が
つながっていて、
これを熟知することで人間を破壊することは容易……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: No, that's the right answer, but the explanation is scary!!
text_block_list.orig_text: いや正解だけど補足が怖い！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hmm, my answer is "Animals that are all doing their best to live!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
うちの答えはねー
『みんながんばって生きているどーぶつ』！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's a wonderful answer!! It's completely different though!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
素敵な答えね！！
全然違うわ！！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Mmm, they all have "type" in common, right? So, it's "animals good at fighting games"! "Type reads combos"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむむ……
どれも『類』がついてますね。
ということはズバリ、
『格闘ゲームが得意な動物』です！
『類はコンボを読む』って言いますから！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: If you're going to say that, then it's "Type calls friends"! That's not what it means!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを言うなら『類は友を呼ぶ』ね！
そういうことじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: The answer is "vertebrates." In simple terms, it means animals with a spine. ...Alright, last question.
text_block_list.orig_text:
答えは『セキツイ動物』よ。
簡単に言えば背骨がある動物ってことね。
……
はいじゃあ最後の問題。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Translate the following sentence into a proverb: No pain, no gain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『次の文章をことわざに訳しなさい。
No pain, no gain.』
さ、
ビシッと答えなさい。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Translated literally, it means "you can't gain without pain"! I got it! The correct answer is, "If you don't enter the tiger's den, you won't get the tiger's cub!"
text_block_list.orig_text:
直訳すると、
痛みがなきゃ利益は得られないってことですよね！
分かりました！　
正解は、
『虎穴にずんだ餅、
虎子を得ず』です！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What's "zunda mochi"!!? "If you don't enter, you won't"!? What's "won't enter"!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずんだ餅ってなによ！！
入らずんばよ！！
……
ってか入らずんばってなによ！！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: It's "If you don't enter the tiger's den, you won't get the tiger's cub!" You see, when I first heard it, I thought it meant sneaking into a tiger's den and stealing its cub like a villain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『虎穴に入らずんば虎子を得ず』デスネ！
初めて聞いた時は、
勝手に巣穴に潜り込み、
赤子を奪う大悪党のことだとバカリ……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I see. From the tiger's perspective, that makes sense. It's important to have a different point of view... I'm thinking about it now... But you don't have to make me think right now!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど。
たしかに虎目線ならそうよね。
何事も別の視点を持つことが大事
……考えさせられるわ。
……って今は考えさせなくていい！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: No pain, no gain, right?♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
「ペインがない、
ゲインもない」
だよね♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's a bit too literal!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: そのまますぎるわ！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Literally, it's 'No pain, no gain.' It means that risks are often involved in obtaining something valuable. An example would be 'If you do not enter the tiger's den, you cannot obtain a tiger cub' as the correct answer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……直訳すると『痛みなくして利益なし』
価値のあるものを手に入れるためには、
危険はつきものってことね。
一例だけど『虎穴に入らずんば虎子を得ず』とかが正解よ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I've got a good sense of your level now. Unfortunately, it looks like studying together is going to be difficult.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
あんたたちのレベルはよく分かったわ。
残念ながら一緒に勉強するのは難しいみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well, thanks for the effort. I'll be cheering for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
お疲れさま。
応援してるわー

text_block_list.name: Suzuna and the others
text_block_list.text:
Kyaru-Chan~~~~!!!
Kyaru-chi~~~~!!!
Kyaru-Chan~~~~!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルちゃ～～～ん！！！
キャルっち～～～！！！
キャルさ～～～ん！！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And as the days passed, the day before the final exams...
text_block_list.orig_text: そして日は経ち、期末試験前日──

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Stare...
text_block_list.orig_text: じーーー……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Full marks on all of them... Phew, the review went perfectly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……丸、
丸、
丸
……最後の問題も、
丸。
ふうー、
復習もばっちりねー！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'm tired. I've been studying non-stop during the preparation period. Let's take it easy today and soak in the bathtub early.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はー疲れた。
準備期間中はずーっと勉強漬けだったもんね。
今日はゆっくり湯船につかって早めに休みましょ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Stare...
text_block_list.orig_text: じーーー……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...I know, alright? Why are you giving me those abandoned Chihuahua eyes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや気付いてるから。
なに捨てられたチワワみたいな目で見てんのよ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Yay!!! Kyaru-chi!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった～！　
キャルっち～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I've told you a million times not to hug me!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: だから抱きついてくんなって何回言わせんのよ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: But, but, Kyaru-chi, you've been studying so much lately that you haven't paid any attention to me, and I've been really lonely!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってだって、
ここ最近キャルっちベンキョーばっかで
うちに構ってくれなくて、
マジさみしかったし～～～！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Are you a needy girlfriend!? Well, since you've begged for it, go ahead and cuddle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
めんどくさい彼女か！？
……
ほら構ってやってんだから離れなさいよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: So...? Did you study properly during the preparation period?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で……？　
期間中ちゃんと勉強してた？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: No, I didn't... It's not like that. I wanted to try my best, but I can't do it alone... I end up falling asleep...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
してない……
違うよ？　
がんばろうとは思ってたんだよ？
でも一人じゃムリ……
寝ちゃうんだもん……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What's that...?
Are you a baby?
Well, there's no helping it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにそれ……
赤ちゃん？
はあ、
まったくしょうがないわねー……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Then, today, my room... will you come?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあ今日、
あたしの部屋……
来る？
一夜漬け程度でどうなるもんでもないと思うけど……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: I'll go!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 行く！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...What about Rino and Ninon?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……リノとニノンは？

text_block_list.name: Rino, Ninon
text_block_list.text: We're coming too!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 行きます！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Eriko is smart, so she won't come, right?
text_block_list.orig_text: エリコは頭良いし来ないわよね？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll be sipping herbal tea and counting {0}-sama's good points.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
私はハーブティーでも飲みながら、
{0}様の好きなところを数えて過ごしますわ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I'm going too!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 私も行きますわ！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Then I'll wait for you after school.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……分かった。
じゃあ放課後待ってるわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I've invited them... I was planning to rest early today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ、
誘っちゃった。
今日は早めに休もうと思ってたのに。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, when was the last time I invited friends to my room...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういや部屋に……
と、
友達……？
呼んだのなんていつぶりかしら。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this desk is big enough... I've prepared cushions for everyone, so your butts shouldn't hurt...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この机で大きさ足りるかしら……
人数分のクッションは用意してるから、
お尻は痛くないと思うけど……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I've prepared plenty of energy drinks for staying awake, and I've even got a blanket for short naps when you get tired... Oh, I almost forgot. I also have aromatherapy for improved concentration...
text_block_list.orig_text:
眠気対策に栄養ドリンクはたくさん用意してるし、
それでも眠い時の仮眠用に毛布も出したわ……
あ、
忘れてた。
集中力アップのためにアロマを……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: They're here...!!

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Kyaru, we're here!
text_block_list.orig_text: お待たせキャルっちー♪

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Well, you've cleaned up quite nicely. I can feel the minimum courtesy of inviting these people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
なかなかきれいに片付いてますわね。
このおかたを招く最低限の配慮は感じますわ。

text_block_list.name: Rino, Ninon
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you!
text_block_list.orig_text: お邪魔しまーす！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hold on a minute!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと待ったーーー！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey... didn't you guys come here to study?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あんたら勉強しに来たのよね～～！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What on earth is all this candy and games in your hands!? And your outfits... Are you planning a pajama party!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一体全体、
何なのよその両手いっぱいのお菓子とゲームは！？
しかもその格好……
パジャマパーティーでもする気！！？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm in charge of snacks! I got potato chips, chocolates, gummy bears, and marshmallows! I chose things that Kyaru-chan seems to like!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！　
お菓子の買い出し担当は私です！
ポテチにチョコにグミにマシュマロ！
キャルちゃんの好きそーなの選びました！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You're going to get fat!
text_block_list.orig_text: 太るわ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: I've prepared games from all over the world! Shogi, playing cards, Hanafuda, and more! We'll finish with a yukata-clad table tennis showdown!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワタシは古今東西、
津々浦々のゲームを用意シマシタ！
ショーギに、
トランプ、
花札イノシカチョー！
締めは浴衣で卓球合戦デース！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Don't mess around!!!

text_block_list.name: Suzuna and the others
text_block_list.text: Gyaaahhh!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃああああああああ！！！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: This is... Kyaru, you suddenly used magic... Wait, aren't these our regular clothes!? Is this the transformation magic Sensei was using...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ……
ひどいよキャルっち～
いきなり魔法を……
って、
あれ！？　
パジャマじゃなくなってる！
これってセンセーの使ってた着せ替え魔法……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Yes, I stole that magic because I'm a genius. Alright, put away the snacks and games! We're here to study!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
あの魔法盗んだのよ天才だから。
はい、
お菓子もゲームもしまいなさい！
勉強するわよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Ehh, but we came all the way to Kyaru-chan's room. It's a waste to study...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～
せっかくキャルっちの部屋に来たのに
ベンキョーなんてもったいないじゃーん……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You guys... you do understand, right? If you get a failing grade on the next exam, you'll have to attend supplementary lessons! And the day of those lessons is the same as the day of the school trip!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたち……
もしかして知らないわけじゃないでしょーね？
今度の試験で赤点取ったら、
補習に参加しなくちゃいけないの！
で、
その補習の日は修学旅行と同じ日！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: In other words, if you get a failing grade, you can't go on the school trip!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
赤点取ったら修学旅行に行けないってことよ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna and the others
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhh!!!???
text_block_list.orig_text: ええええええええ！！！？？？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Afterward, thanks to Kyaru's thorough guidance, Suzuna and the others managed to avoid failing the exams by a narrow margin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、キャルの徹底指導の甲斐もあり、
何とかギリギリで赤点を免れたスズナたち。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Everyone rejoiced at being able to go on the school trip, and they lifted Kyaru up in celebration.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に修学旅行に行けることになった一同は、
歓喜の声をあげてキャルを胴上げしたのだった。
